citations.title: David Velez, CEO of Nubank: Revolutionising Banking in LATAM

sentences.text: David Velez Osorno is the founder, chairman and chief executive officer of Nu Holdings Ltd., the parent of digital bank Nubank, and signed the principal executive officer certification for the company's Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, as chairman and chief executive officer.

Born in Medellin, Colombia, in 1981, he is a Colombian banker, engineer and entrepreneur, and holds a bachelor of science in management science and engineering from Stanford University and an MBA from the Stanford Graduate School of Business.

He also spent time as a partner at Sequoia Capital from 2011 to 2013
sentences.text: Before Nubank he worked in investment banking at Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs, in private equity at General Atlantic, and as a partner at Sequoia Capital from 2011 to 2013 leading its Latin American investments.
